name: Randomized matrix decomposition framework
inference_algorithm: Draw Gaussian probes Omega; compute Y=A Omega and orthonormalize by QR; optionally use (AA*)^q A with intermediate orthonormalization; compress to Q* A and factor deterministically.
estimand: Approximate range basis and low-rank QR or SVD factorization of A.
data_input: An m by n matrix A; matrix products with A and, for power/SVD steps, A*.
tunable_settings: Target rank k; oversampling p (sample size ell=k+p); power exponent q.
